description: getDeployment's 200 response is a 3-arm oneOf: arm 0 omits readySubstate (arms 1-2 declare it), so the generated merged GetDeploymentResponseBody loses the field even though the live API returns it (readySubstate PROMOTED observed on every promoted production deployment — see alchemy processes/Vercel/PROBES.md). Also no arm's readyState enum includes DELETED, which the live API returns for a deleted deployment (DELETE probe: 200 {state:"DELETED"}, subsequent GETs report the deployment with readyState DELETED). Add readySubstate to arm 0 and DELETED to every top-level readyState enum.
